confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living estimates and a few Dresden menu prices gathered in 2026. Restaurant meal and beer anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine are weaker: the wine glass price is inferred from the local beer price, not a found by-the-glass price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings. The FX observation of 2026-11-19 is provisional, and EUR amounts were converted at an assumed rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Dresden's own cost-of-living estimates and menu prices, cross-checked against other mid-sized German cities with similar tourist demand. Accommodation uses the same regional basis for a mid-sized German city in peak summer.
